messages.text: I want a refund for my cordless hand mixer. I haven't mailed it back yet—I'll post it next week—but since I paid with both a credit card and a boleto, shouldn't a staff member take over my case right now?

messages.text:
Not yet. The shop must receive your cordless hand mixer back before a refund can be requested, so I won’t create a request now. (refund-policy/v2/return)

Multiple payment records normally require staff review, but they do not override the return requirement or trigger a handoff now. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)

Your refund request must be made by **7 December 2026 at 10:00 UTC**, after the mixer arrives back. (refund-policy/v2/window)
